notes: Dockerfile.final created for Apache Flink CDC benchmark environment. Uses debian:bookworm base image with Java 8 (Temurin JDK 8u412) and Maven 3.8.7. The Dockerfile copies setup_runtime.sh and repo_setup.sh from build context to /opt/benchmark/, executes repo_setup.sh first to materialize /workspace from the Apache Flink CDC git repository, then executes setup_runtime.sh to install Java 8 and pre-cache Maven dependencies. WORKDIR is set to /workspace. The image is ready for RL agent execution. Buildah validation should be performed next.
